description: This file is a build script that generates a build stamp file containing the current timestamp and the current Git HEAD commit hash, primarily used for build versioning.

methods.name: resolveGitHead
methods.description: Executes 'git rev-parse HEAD' to retrieve the current Git commit hash, returning null if unsuccessful.

methods.name: writeBuildStamp
methods.description: Creates a build stamp file containing the timestamp and Git HEAD hash to mark the build.
